title: Implant starts working after Anne's death and spells out 'it's me'

tellings.quote: And the words slow down and it says very clearly coming across, it's me and

plain: After his wife, Anne Strieber, died in 2015, the writer Whitley Strieber says an implant, an object he believes was placed in his body during his encounters, began to work, and words came through it that slowed down and said "very clearly", "it's me". He tells Michels this as his own experience and takes the message as coming from Anne. If true, it would suggest the implant can carry contact from the dead.
